cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
rng=random.Random(11)
S=256; J=512; F=32; G=32
step=1000
times=[s*step for s in range(S)]
groups=[]
for g in range(G):
    parent=-1 if g<3 else rng.choice([-1,g-1,rng.randint(0,g-1)])
    groups.append([parent,512])
flows=[]
for f in range(F):
    flows.append([16 if f<30 else 4, 512, -1 if f%5==0 else rng.randint(0,G-1), rng.randint(0,6)])
windows=[]
for j in range(J):
    f=j%F
    windows.append([f,0,times[-1],1,1,0,rng.randint(1,1000),[[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
case={'model':'cnn','class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],'stats':[100,100000,1000000],
 'bucket':[512,512],'slots':[[times[s],512,0 if s==0 else 512] for s in range(S)],'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows}
json.dump({'version':3,'cases':[case]},open('/workspace/tmp/stress_full.json','w'))
print('written')
PYEOF
ls -la /workspace/tmp/stress_full.json; cd /workspace && time (python3 public_exec.py /workspace/submission/main.py < /workspace/tmp/stress_full.json > /workspace/tmp/stress_full.out 2>/workspace/tmp/stress_full.err; echo exit=$?); ls -la /workspace/tmp/stress_full.out; head -c 400 /workspace/tmp/stress_full.err
